page.overview:
Who is Narmacil II?

Narmacil II was the twenty-ninth King of Gondor and the son of Telumehtar.

In the second year of his reign a confederation of Easterlings called the Wainriders began to raid the eastern territories of Gondor. Five years later they invaded in force, overrunning the eastern territories. Narmacil marched to Rhovanion to fight the invaders but was utterly defeated and slain in the Battle of the Plains. He was one-hundred and seventy-two years old and ruled for only six years. He was succeeded by his son Calimehtar.

The name Narmacil is Quenya for 'fire-sword', from the words nár, meaning 'fire', and macil, meaning 'sword'.
